platforms.text:
Setting up Codex, Claude Code, OpenClaw and Hermes means wrestling four different installers, each with its own config, keys and driver dance. For people in China it's worse: most endpoints are unreachable without a proxy.

I built U-King, a free desktop "AI installer & workbench" for Windows (and a Mac build): you tell it what you want in plain conversation, it installs the tools, configures a reachable model driver, and verifies the connection before telling you "done".

Highlights:
- One dialogue-based setup for Codex / Claude Code / OpenClaw / Hermes
- Auto-configures model providers that work in China without a VPN
- Built-in terminal with a first-run guide and six quick prompts (write a report, make a table, write code, find a bug…)
- Usage meter with cost-per-day + saving tips, no hidden meters
- Free, portable .exe available (no install needed for the green version)

Site: https://u-king.org
Windows: https://u-claw.org.cn/download/U-King.exe
Mac: https://u-claw.org.cn/download/U-King-Mac.dmg

# 装好全部 AI，一个软件就够了

在国内给同事、给客户装 Codex / Claude Code，最痛的不是模型不行，是**装机**。

四个工具四个安装器，PATH 要配、Key 要填、模型驱动要对得上，而且默认端点在国内全连不上——不翻墙就没法用。

## U-King：对话式装机管家

U-King 是一个免费的 Windows/Mac 桌面工具（也有免安装的绿色版），核心就一件事：**用对话把 AI 工具装好、配好、验证好**。

- 对话式安装 Codex / Claude Code / OpenClaw / Hermes
- 自动配置国内可直连的模型驱动，**装完先实测连通，再提示「装好了」**
- 内置终端 + 首次引导卡 + 六个快捷词（写周报 / 做表格 / 写代码 / 找 Bug / 翻译文档 / 总结会议）
- 用量曲线：本地记 Token 水电表，按天读数，附省钱建议

## 为什么值得试

装机这件事，应该像「装一个 App」一样简单。U-King 把装 AI 工具拉平到了这个门槛：不用翻墙、不用填 Key、不用读教程，对话里说完就装。
